    • of

      public static CliComponent of(Component component)
      Factory method to create a CliComponent based on the type of Component. The switch is based on the sealed class Component.
      Parameters:
      component - The component to be represented in the CLI
      Returns:
      A CliComponent or its subclass based on the type of the component

    • getConnector

      public String getConnector(Direction direction)
      Returns the connector character for the specified direction. The character is determined based on the component's rotated connector in that direction.
      Parameters:
      direction - The direction for which to get the connector character
      Returns:
      A string representing the connector character for the specified direction

    • getId

      public int getId()
      Returns the ID of the component. This ID is used to identify the component in the game state.
      Returns:
      The unique identifier of the component

    • highlight

      public void highlight(CliHighlights color)
      Highlights the component with the specified color. This method sets the open and close strings to the highlight color.
      Parameters:
      color - The color to use for highlighting
